snippet.title: Pale Tide - Official Reveal Trailer | The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
snippet.description: Don't miss the Reveal Trailer for Pale Tide, a top-down action-adventure survival game. Players will set out into a world on its knees with their trusty dog companion to scavenge for supplies, speak to other survivors, and survive terrifying hordes of the undead. Pale Tide is coming soon to PC (Steam).
